messages:
incident_bot: [ALERT] SLO breach detected: streaming p99 spikes -> 2.1s (baseline 0.9s) across eu-west-1. Error type: streaming stalls; correlated with recent fp8 precision profile rollout (deconv kernel opt). auto-page: oncall_tom :rotating_light:
oncall_tom: acked, joining
sre_amy: seeing same in dashboards, p95 also up ~0.8s -> 1.6s. tracing shows a backlog on deconv operator during kv reloads. stack traces include repeated dequant calls.
ml_ravi: rolled fp8 profile for model:gpt-small-v2 ~ 16:10 UTC; metrics were green in canary but scale uncovered a regression. suspicious: runtime falls back to software dequant path intermittently causing stalls.
oncall_tom: tagging @ml_ravi @sre_amy. what's quick mitigation? we should avoid customer impact.
ml_ravi: short term: revert profile to fp16 for traffic groups with streaming=true. I can push a rollback to model profile config now. will need deploy_bot approval.
deploy_bot: queueing config rollback job #r-5222. requires oncall signoff to proceed in prod. runbook step suggests rollback then monitor 15m.
oncall_tom: approve rollback, proceed. :thumbsup:
deploy_bot: started job r-5222 -> applying profile override: model:gpt-small-v2 -> precision=fp16 for route=/stream/* . ETA ~ 45s.
infra_jp: FYI observed pod-level CPU saturation on dequant workers before rollback, likely because kernel fallback triggers CPU path. spike aligns with traffic burst at 16:23 UTC.
sre_amy: adding a short helper to reroute streaming to higher memory nodes to reduce preemption of dequant threads. patching autoscaler policy: prefer nodepool=highmem for route=/stream/*
ml_ravi: sharing quick rollback command for config service:

```
curl -X POST https://config.redwood/api/v1/overrides \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-small-v2","route":"/stream/*","precision":"fp16","reason":"fp8-streaming-tail-regress-revert"}'
```

oncall_tom: ran that, api returned 200, config rollout started. monitoring logs.
nicole_cs: heads up from CS — 2 customers opened tickets reporting slow streaming completions and some timeouts; one on a paid Dedicated account. I flagged to account team and legal is watching for SLA implications.
oncall_tom: pinging @nicole_cs for customer list and impact level. we'll prioritize dedicated tenant first.
nicole_cs: affected_tenants: [acme-markets, bluebox-legal]. acme has high-traffic chatflows using streaming for live transcripts. bluebox reported 4 timed-out sessions. we're preparing customer comms if SLA breach confirmed.
sre_amy: rollback completed around 16:24:30 UTC. initial metrics: p99 dropped from 2.1s -> 0.95s within 3 min. p95 back to ~0.9s. traces show deconv queue drained.
ml_ravi: digging into why fp8 produced fallback. early hypothesis: quant calibration in deconv kernel produced NaN scales for certain tokens leading runtime to trigger fallback. collecting calibration logs now.
infra_jp: saving heap/threads dumps from affected hosts (job id: hdump-5222). attaching to this thread after upload.
ml_ravi: important: calibration artifacts show that for certain sequence lengths >2048 the scale table had outliers. will open a patch to tighten clamp and add guard rails in autocalib.
oncall_tom: good recovery. handing off to next-shift: @sre_amy will take lead for postmortem and rollback verification, @ml_ravi to own root-cause and kernel fix, @infra_jp to collect infra artifacts. paging cleared? incident_bot: page cleared by oncall_tom.
incident_bot: incident severity downgraded to sev3; timeline updated. next update due in 2h for RCA draft.
sre_amy: logging action items: 1) postmortem + RCA (sre_amy) 2) autocalib guard clamps + unit tests (ml_ravi) 3) add e2e load test for streaming+fp8 (sre_amy + infra_jp) 4) customer outreach draft (nicole_cs). will create tasks and link.
nicole_cs: drafting customer note: shared root cause (fp8 calibration edge-case), mitigation (profile rollback), current status (latency normalized), next steps (hotfix + long-term test). will share draft in #customer-success in 30m.
ml_ravi: creating PR with clamp and revert tests. PR: https://git.redwood/ml/commit/cc7d48 - will request review from @sre_amy.
oncall_tom: handing off to next oncall at 17:00 UTC (shift change). @sre_amy you'll be primary until handoff completes. thanks team.

-- end of thread (keeping full logs here for postmortem)
